configurePresets.name: sdl-renderer
configurePresets.displayName: SDL_RENDERER — Most portable renderer, and CNA's default off Linux
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: sdl-gpu
configurePresets.displayName: SDL_GPU — SDL3's own GPU abstraction
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: system libshaderc.

configurePresets.name: opengles3
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGLES3 — CNA's default renderer on Linux
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: sibling ../easy-gl (which needs ../meta-gl).

configurePresets.name: opengles2
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGLES2 — Internally EasyGL, GLES 2.0 profile
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: sibling ../easy-gl (which needs ../meta-gl).

configurePresets.name: opengl33
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGL33 — Internally EasyGL, desktop GL 3.3 core profile
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: sibling ../easy-gl (which needs ../meta-gl).

configurePresets.name: web-webgl2
configurePresets.displayName: WEBGL2 — CNA's default renderer under Emscripten
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: sibling ../easy-gl (which needs ../meta-gl).

configurePresets.name: web-webgl1
configurePresets.displayName: WEBGL1 — WebGL 1 profile
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: sibling ../easy-gl (which needs ../meta-gl).

configurePresets.name: opengl1
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGL1 — Legacy fixed-function OpenGL 1.x
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows. Dependency: system OpenGL.

configurePresets.name: opengl2
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGL2 — Desktop OpenGL 2.1 compatibility profile, GLSL 1.10
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: system OpenGL.

configurePresets.name: opengl4
configurePresets.displayName: OPENGL4 — Real desktop OpenGL 4.x core profile, independent of EasyGL
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: system OpenGL.

configurePresets.name: vulkan
configurePresets.displayName: VULKAN — Real 3D via Vulkan
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows. Dependency: system Vulkan SDK (find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)).

configurePresets.name: webgpu
configurePresets.displayName: WEBGPU — Despite the name this is a NATIVE renderer; CNA rejects it under Emscripten
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: wgpu-native binary release, auto-downloaded.

configurePresets.name: metal
configurePresets.displayName: METAL — macOS only
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: macos. Dependency: Apple Metal framework.

configurePresets.name: headless
configurePresets.displayName: HEADLESS — No GPU and no window at all
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: software
configurePresets.displayName: SOFTWARE — Real CPU rasterizer
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: stub
configurePresets.displayName: STUB — Deliberate no-op renderer
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: portablegl
configurePresets.displayName: PORTABLEGL — CPU OpenGL 3.x-style pipeline
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: PortableGL single header via FetchContent.

configurePresets.name: tinygl
configurePresets.displayName: TINYGL — CPU fixed-function OpenGL 1.x subset
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos, android. Dependency: C-Chads/tinygl via FetchContent.

configurePresets.name: blend2d
configurePresets.displayName: BLEND2D — Blend2D CPU vector rasterizer, presented through an SDL texture
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: Blend2D + asmjit via FetchContent.

configurePresets.name: web-canvas
configurePresets.displayName: CANVAS — Browser 2D canvas context
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: web-html-dom
configurePresets.displayName: HTML_DOM — Draws sprites as pooled CSS-transformed <div> elements
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: web-svg-dom
configurePresets.displayName: SVG_DOM — Draws sprites as real <svg>/<image> elements
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: none.

configurePresets.name: web-pixijs
configurePresets.displayName: PIXIJS — PixiJS retained-mode WebGL scene graph for SpriteBatch and render targets
configurePresets.description: 2D renderer. Platforms: web. Dependency: pinned PixiJS v7 UMD build.

configurePresets.name: bgfx
configurePresets.displayName: BGFX — bgfx cross-platform renderer
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: bgfx via FetchContent (pinned, patched).

configurePresets.name: sokol
configurePresets.displayName: SOKOL — Adds CNA_SOKOL_API (GLCORE default; only GLCORE is verified upstream)
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: sokol single header via FetchContent + system OpenGL.

configurePresets.name: fna3d
configurePresets.displayName: FNA3D — The XNA-shaped C library FNA renders through
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: FNA3D + MojoShader via FetchContent; needs Python3.

configurePresets.name: freedirect
configurePresets.displayName: FREEDIRECT — DirectDraw reimplemented on SDL3, so unlike DIRECTX* it builds on Linux
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: linux, windows, macos. Dependency: sibling ../free-direct.

configurePresets.name: windows-directx11
configurePresets.displayName: DIRECTX11 — Direct3D 11
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: windows. Dependency: d3d11.h/dxgi.h.

configurePresets.name: windows-directx12
configurePresets.displayName: DIRECTX12 — Direct3D 12
configurePresets.description: 2D3D renderer. Platforms: windows. Dependency: d3d12.h/dxgi.h.
